Cc: Greenlane AP Team <ap@greenlane-pay.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery options + PO mapping

Hi Soojin,

Quick question from our AP side as we finalize the vendor list: what are our options for receiving invoices from Redwood? Our preference is a single system-of-record ingest (we use Coupa) but if that's not available we need a reliable fallback. A couple of specifics:

- Can you push invoices to an SFTP endpoint or provide a signed PDF email?
- We need PO-to-invoice mapping — can you include our PO ID in the invoice metadata or filename?
- For EU transactions there is sometimes reverse-charge VAT; how do you surface VAT tags on the invoice?

If easier, we can provide an AP contact email alias that you can send to while we enroll with portal/webhook. For now please send an example invoice layout and any sample mapping CSVs.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Moreno
Director, Accounts Payable
Greenlane Payments

Attachment: greenlane_po-mapping-template.csv (CSV, 2KB)

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options + PO mapping

Alicia — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front then details below.

- We can do portal webhook (preferred for near-real-time ingest) or nightly SFTP batches. We also support email-delivered signed PDFs as a temporary fallback.
- Yes, we can embed your PO ID in the invoice XML metadata and include it in the filename (PO12345_redwood-INV-20280601.xml).
- VAT tags: we include fields for tax_type and reverse_charge=true in the XML and a VAT summary block on the PDF.

I'm attaching a sample invoice XML and a signed-PDF stub for your AP team to review. Connor, can you confirm SFTP host name + credentials flow? Kimberly, flag any legal/VAT constraints you want surfaced to the invoice renderer.

Proposed onboarding approach (two-step):
1) Temporary: send signed PDF copies to the alias ap@greenlane-pay.com and include a CSV mapping column PO_ID so your system can auto-attach.
2) Final: enroll Greenlane for portal webhook/SFTP delivery within 2–4 weeks; emails are kept as fallback for 90 days.

Next steps: Alicia, if you confirm the temporary alias, we'll start daily pushes tonight at 11PM PT.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Head, Partnerships — Billing Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_invoice_sample_v2.xml (XML, 5KB); signed-invoice-stub.pdf (PDF, 20KB)

From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options + PO mapping

Looping in SRE ops notes for the SFTP option — runbook highlights:

- Host: sftp.redwood-inference.com (SFTP account per-customer).
- Provisioning: we generate an SSH keypair and provide onboarding instructions via secure link (we don't email private keys).
- Schedule: nightly batch at 23:00 PT (delta file + manifest).
- Filename convention: GRNLN_PO{POID}_INV{YYYYMMDD}.xml (we can add a hash suffix if you require immutability).

I'll create the onboarding ticket and the temporary bridge for tonight if Alicia confirms the alias. Also note: if Greenlane needs signed PDFs we can GPG sign the file and include a checksum file in the SFTP manifest.

—Connor
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference

Alicia — a couple of compliance/metadata items from legal that affect the invoice payload: 

- We need the seller TAX_ID and the invoice issuer signature block on every invoice (PDF and XML).
- For reverse-charge cases include a clear "reverse_charge" element and a short line on the PDF: "Reverse charge applies — buyer liable for VAT."
- Retention: per contract we must retain transactional metadata for 7 years; we will include a hashed-stub with each pushed file (hash of invoice payload + timestamp) so both parties have a stable audit key.

If Greenlane has any restrictions on storing hashes/third-party PII please flag now — we can strip PII from the manifest while preserving the mapping key.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
